    structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ClosedZigzagCrossCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] :
    Type u

    Coefficients on the identity and arrow Hom spaces of a closed zigzag, with the naturality equations separated into two parts. The identity_middle_whisker field is exactly the endpoint-endomorphism part handled by split residue maps and endpoint-radical coefficients. The last field is the genuinely cross-arrow condition: whiskering an ambient Hom for which the source category has no middle path must have zero coefficient in a landing arrow line.

    • coefficient {X Y : LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ} : Quiver.Path (LinearPathCategory.vertex Y) (LinearPathCategory.vertex X) → (D.obj X ⟶ D.obj Y) →ₗ[k] k

      def LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.ClosedZigzagCrossCoefficientData.toThinPathCoefficientData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {n : ℕ} {hn : 2 ≤ n} {D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C} [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] (h : ClosedZigzagCrossCoefficientData n hn D) :
      ThinPathCoefficientData D

      In a radical-square-zero alternating zigzag, the endpoint equations and cross-arrow vanishing are sufficient for all two-variable coefficient equations. If the middle path is an arrow, both outer paths must be identities and the equation is formal; if it is an identity, use the endpoint field; if it does not exist, use the cross field.
